purpose: Train relative ordering of separate true source hypotheses above high-ranked acoustic aliases while retaining a binary false-alarm anchor
inputs: Existing native33 frozen TRAIN teacher prefix; no new runtime features
objective: Binary Bernoulli anchor plus NDCG-weighted positive/negative pairwise Newton corrections; max32 hard negatives plus exact ties per causal TRAIN snapshot
labels: Same TRAIN-only maximum-cardinality one-to-one source assignment as G90; .08m nearby aliases retain zero gradient/weight
normalization: Each snapshot keeps the same total original world budget; pair gradients sum to zero within a query
negative_worlds: No ranking pairs, so the binary anchor still learns absolute false-alarm rejection
reference_scope: RankNet/LambdaRank pairwise gradient principle; anchor, normalization and hard-negative cap are project-specific
